egis.note: LOWHIDE SHIEN. Tip-run dedicated egi with one-touch swappable sinker. Weights are SINKER weights (spec says e.g. '3号 (シンカー：30g用)'); total egi weight not stated. Colour availability per colour chart: #001-#007 and #010 = 2.5/3/3.5号; #008 UVオーシャンブルー and #009 情熱オレンジ/ピンク = 2.5号 only; #011-#014 and #024-#029 = 3/3.5号 only; #015RT-#020RT = rattle models 3号RT/3.5号RT only. NOTE: the page's summary text line numbers colours differently (#001-#026, '全26色', e.g. #008 オリーブアジ, #021 ストライプエメラルドGR); the numbering used here is from the colour chart images. All parts SUS316 stainless. ¥1,550-1,650 excl. tax.
